title: Suppressing electrostatic potential fluctuations to achieve high-efficiency organic photovoltaic cells for laser wireless energy transfer
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE01440A, Paper
Yang Xiao, Yong Cui, Haoyu Yuan, Jingwen Wang, Zhihao Chen, GuanLin Wang, Wei Fu, Zhen Fu, Yafei Wang, Tao Zhang, Yue Yu, Runnan Yu, Guangzheng Zuo, Maojie Zhang, Xiaotao Hao, Jianhui Hou
The wide-bandgap acceptor AITO-2F was synthesized to explore the impact of molecular aggregation on electrostatic potential fluctuations, achieving remarkable PCE and FF under AM 1.5G and 660 nm laser illumination.
